title: Experimental estimates for business openings and closures by employment size for Canada, provinces and territories, census metropolitan areas, seasonally adjusted
license_notes: Statistics Canada Open Government Licence - Canada; consult source terms before reuse.
definition_notes: Experimental monthly aggregate counts. A closure is a Statistics Canada business-dynamics measure and is not asserted here to be a permanent enterprise death, insolvency, bankruptcy, or a cause of failure.
extraction_criteria: Normalizer retains only GEO Canada and Quebec; all NAICS and employment-size categories; business dynamics Openings and Closures; rows with a nonblank VALUE. Raw ZIP is gitignored.
